svg.text: nrw aure new + nrw aure run · what nr-workbench hands AuRE's LLM pipeline
nr-workbench writes no prompt here: it composes the setup every AuRE prompt reads, pins the budget and the knobs, and runs aure analyze as a subprocess
nrw aure new · the setup
setup.yaml · nrw aure run
AuRE's LLM CALLS (one state, 3 segments)

g.text: samples/<id>/aure/<id>-<run>/setup.yaml
name: Sample6-218386
sample_description: |-
~50 nm Cu on ~3 nm Ti on a Si wafer, in d8-THF with
1 M LiBF4, measured through the silicon substrate. …
Electrochemical cell with the Cu film as the working …
The condition of run 218386: OCV, before the EIS sequence.
Measurement conditions: Mounted once and left in the cell …
states:
- name: state0
data_files:
- file: samples/Sample6/data/steady/REFL_218386_1_218386_partial.txt
- file: …_2_218387_partial.txt
- file: …_3_218388_partial.txt
back_reflection: true
hypothesis: Co-refine 218386 and 218393 with the 218389 series. …
fit_method: de · fit_steps: 300 · max_refinements: 2
written by nrw aure run --budget quick (the default)
nrw aure run <setup>
without --dry-run, refused by the hook:
a run bills for as long as it takes, and would put a second
model's judgement where the harness's was wanted
needs an endpoint: AuRE is language-model driven throughout
the budget, written into setup.yaml:
quick de, 300 steps, max_refinements: 2
standard AuRE's defaults: dream 1000/1000, max_refinements: 5
AuRE counts max_refinements in evaluations: quick is two
evaluations around one refinement; standard allows up to four
the knobs, pinned in the environment → run-env.json:
MODE_ENUMERATION=0 (1 with --mode-enumeration)
THIN_LAYER_MODE_K=1.0 THIN_LAYER_MODE_SEEDS=3
ROUGHNESS_MAX_OUTER unset FINAL_SELECTION_TOL=0.02
FINAL_TIER_CHI2_FACTOR=3.0 USE_RUN_TITLE=0
then, as a subprocess, the aure beside this Python:
aure analyze -c setup.yaml -o output --verbose
sample.md · the prose AuRE builds from
## Description + ## Details
→ sample_description; nothing there → refused, with
what to write: layers, what it sits in, the beam side
run N's condition · ## Measurement conditions
· run N's notes
appended to it. AuRE 1.0.2 declares a state's
extra_description but no prompt reads it, so a
contrast written only there never reached the model
the files · exact
sample.yaml, else nrw sample scan
--run N when the sample has more than one steady run
its per-angle partials, in segment order (else the
combined file) → one state, state0
data_dir points back at the project root
geometry · back_reflection_stated()
"through the silicon substrate", "back reflection", …
read with the negation before it: "not through the
substrate" says no. Silence leaves it unset, with a warning
hypothesis · ## Fits to perform
sent word for word: to the parse ("The hypothesis to test
is: …"), to the ranking as its top candidate (origin="user"),
and to every evaluation. Here it is the co-refinement task,
handed to a fit of one run
checked by AuRE's own loader
aure.setup.load_setup(setup.yaml)
written first, then loaded back: data_files resolve
relative to the file. No model is called. A setup that
sets llm_api_key, llm_base_url, llm_provider, llm_model,
llm_temperature or llm_timeout is refused: a shared file
must not choose where this machine's key is sent

svg.text: first · aure analyze checks the endpoint

g.text: _check_llm_status() · "Reply with only the word 'OK'" ×1
in every output mode; no answer → "Cannot proceed", exit 1

svg.text: intake · every call one HumanMessage at temperature 0

g.text: select_skills() · _SKILL_SELECTION_PROMPT ×2
before the sample is parsed, and again after, with the parse;
reads sample_description. The catalog is AuRE's own bundled
skills (aure/skills/), not the project's skills/reflectometry/
parse_file_header() · _HEADER_METADATA_PROMPT ×3
one per data file: the first 40 lines of each data_files entry
→ dQ convention, θ, segments, instrument; no model → the parser
parse_sample_with_llm() · SAMPLE_PARSE_PROMPT ×1
reads sample_description, hypothesis and the selected skills
→ ParsedSample: substrate, layers, ambient, intensity …
generate_structural_hypotheses_with_llm() ×1
reads sample_description, the parse, hypothesis (folded in first)
→ the ranked structural_hypotheses list

svg.text: analysis, the first model and the fit: deterministic, no model
after each fit

g.text: analyze_fit_quality_with_llm() · FIT_EVALUATION_PROMPT ×1
AuRE's own evaluator, every slot filled from its run: features, residual
fringes, the χ²/BIC trajectory, the hypotheses. nrw assess has its own
select_skills() + propose_hypothesis_revision_with_llm() gated, ×2
skills re-selected from the fit's observations, then the proposal;
only for a fit that was not accepted, and then only on residual
fringes, a χ² stall, or no pending hypothesis left
_refine_model() · MODEL_REFINEMENT_JSON_PROMPT ×1 per round
before a further fit, unless all that changed is a widened bound;
--budget quick allows one: its second evaluation reaches max_refinements: 2

svg.text: a quick run on this setup: 9 calls if the first fit is accepted; 11 with its one
refinement (10 if that round only widens a bound), and up to 15 when the
revision gate opens after both evaluations
not run for this setup
_extract_per_state_structure() and _extract_cross_state_unshared() need two
states or more, and nrw aure new always writes one
the templates themselves: AuRE's docs/intake-llm.svg · evaluation-llm.svg · modeling-llm.svg
AFTERWARDS · the AuRE run is reconnaissance; the fit that counts is nrw's
nrw aure import <output> --sample S --name first
No model: the fitted model in output/ becomes an ordinary
samples/<id>/models/first.yaml, with a header naming
the AuRE run it came from.
then the normal path
nrw model generate → nrw fit run, with full provenance:
the AuRE run itself carries no fit record.
Quick fit with AuRE · nrw serve
The page runs these same commands as one job:
aure new, aure run --budget=quick, aure import,
then nrw fit run with the project's fitter.

source: nr_workbench/aure_setup.py (compose · describe_sample · measurement_context · back_reflection_stated) · commands/aure_cmd.py (run_aure_new · run_aure_run · _invoke) · aure_adapter.py (validate_setup)
AuRE side read from aure/nodes/{intake,evaluation,modeling}.py and aure/skills/selector.py; the setup is the one written for the Cu/THF reference sample
